scope: DEV calibration, no robot external force, no contact, duration up to 5 seconds
rationale: Propagation uses 20 percent of inherited 5 mm / 1 degree gates; volume uses 20 percent of initial 2 mm guide buffer. Momentum budgets are absolute (not action-scaled): at 300 kg base mass and about 37 kg m^2 base inertia, over 5 s they correspond to roughly 17 um translation and 0.008 degrees rotation, below propagation budgets. This is a declared numeric calibration requirement, not a hardware guarantee.
